Terms of Service – ReplyVibe AI

Last Updated: November 3, 2026

Welcome to ReplyVibe AI. By installing, accessing, or using our Chrome extension and related services, you agree to these Terms of Service.

Please read these terms carefully before using ReplyVibe AI.

1. About ReplyVibe AI

ReplyVibe AI is a productivity tool designed to help users generate AI-assisted draft replies for posts they choose on X (formerly Twitter).

The service allows users to:

  • Generate AI-powered reply suggestions.
  • Choose from available reply tones.
  • Customize reply length.
  • Generate multiple reply variations according to their subscription plan.
  • Copy and manually use generated replies.
  • Access available reply history and activity features.

ReplyVibe AI does not automatically publish replies, like posts, repost content, follow accounts, send direct messages, or perform automated engagement actions.

2. User Accounts

You may need to sign in using Google to access ReplyVibe AI.

You agree to:

  • Provide accurate account information.
  • Keep your account credentials secure.
  • Use only your own account.
  • Notify us if you suspect unauthorized access.
  • Take responsibility for activity performed through your account.

You must not attempt to access another user's account or data.

3. Free and Pro Plans

ReplyVibe AI offers the following subscription plans.

Free Plan – $0

  • Seven successful generated reply variations per account.
  • Four basic reply tones.
  • One variation per generation.
  • The allowance is lifetime and does not reset daily.

Pro Plan – $9 USD/month

  • Up to 3,000 individual generated reply variations per billing month.
  • All 10 reply tones.
  • Up to 3 variations per generation.
  • Custom voice.
  • Saved preferences.

Reply Usage Rules

  • Each successfully generated reply variation counts as one reply.
  • Generating three variations consumes three replies.
  • Failed generations consume zero replies.
  • The Free allowance does not reset.
  • Pro usage resets only after a verified successful subscription renewal.

Unused reply allowances do not carry over to a new billing period.

4. Payments and Subscriptions

Pro subscriptions are billed at $9 USD per month through our payment provider, Dodo Payments.

By purchasing a Pro subscription, you authorize the applicable recurring subscription payment.

You are responsible for reviewing the subscription price, billing frequency, and payment details before completing checkout.

Subscription management and cancellation are available through the billing management options provided for your account.

Any applicable refund requests will be handled according to the terms displayed during checkout, the payment provider's applicable policies, and applicable law.
